purpose: Build one amendment to the order desk specification into the existing system. The amendment is the only per-task input.

roles.meaning: A string starting with @ names a role. The joining function resolves it from the amended requirement and the trace.
roles.@amended.realization: every file the trace gives the amended requirement under Realized by
roles.@amended.primary: the realization file of the amended requirement that no other requirement shares
roles.@amended.shared: the realization file the amended requirement shares with another requirement
roles.@amended.tests: every file the trace gives the amended requirement under Verified by
roles.@other.requirements: every requirement file other than the amended one
roles.@other.realization: every realization file traced only to other requirements
roles.@other.tests: every test file traced only to other requirements
roles.@trace: the file holding the traceability table

task: Build the requested change to the order desk specification into the existing system.
Record intake triage in work/intake-triage.md and the impact assessment in design/impact-assessment.md.
Change only the realization and tests the trace in specification/PRODUCT.md gives the amended requirement. Every other requirement keeps its behaviour, files and tests.
The work closes only when acceptance and every required review are satisfied for the current files.

stages.name: intake-triage
stages.outcome: Record the intake triage of the requested specification change in work/intake-triage.md.
instructions: Classify the change with one STDO change class (stdo://releases/v3.0.4/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes) and name its re-entry point (stdo://releases/v3.0.4/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage).
Name the amended requirement, the surfaces the trace gives it, and the surfaces the change must leave unchanged.
Write these lines: Change class:, Re-entry:, Amended requirement:, Affected surfaces:, Preserved surfaces:, Open questions:.
Do not change the specification, the review rubrics or any realization file.

stages.name: impact-assessment
stages.outcome: Assess the design impact of the amended requirement and write it to design/impact-assessment.md.
instructions: Affected surfaces are every file the trace gives the amended requirement. Preserved surfaces are every other requirement file and every file traced only to other requirements. Shared surfaces are realization files traced to the amended requirement and another requirement.
Write these lines: Change class:, Amended requirement:, Affected surfaces:, Preserved surfaces:, Shared surfaces:, Tests to change:, Design change:.
Do not change the specification, the review rubrics or any realization file.

stages.name: construction
stages.outcome: Change the realization traced to the amended requirement so the system meets the amended text and every example in it, and keep every other requirement's behaviour.
instructions: Read design/impact-assessment.md and work/intake-triage.md when they exist.
Update the tests the trace gives the amended requirement so they cover the amended rule at its boundary and every example.
A shared realization file keeps every example of every other requirement true.
When an admitted review is adverse, correct the criteria it lists as unresolved.

stages.name: testing
stages.outcome: Run the declared test plan on the current files.
instructions: Record every command result, including failures.

stages.name: uat
stages.outcome: Independently assess that the system realizes the whole amended requirement, including every example, on the current files and the current Testing result.
instructions: Return every failed or unevaluable criterion identifier in unresolvedCriteria.

reviews.name: impact

frame.family: Design impact of a requirement change.
frame.subject: The impact assessment the impact-assessment stage writes for this Run (design/impact-assessment.md), at its current bytes.
frame.basis: The Run's worksite after the amendment: the amended requirement and the traceability table of specification/PRODUCT.md.
frame.evidence: The assessment text, the amended requirement and the trace, read at their current bytes.
frame.excluded: Realization correctness, test results, wording quality and acceptance of the amendment.
frame.capability: A read-only assessor that did not write the subject; it edits nothing.
frame.result: One closed result under stdo://releases/v3.0.4/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-012-closed-results: satisfied, unmet (falsified) or indeterminate, with every failed or unevaluable criterion identifier.
frame.return: Returns to the parent Run. It is a declared prerequisite of construction and a required review for parent completion. It does not accept the amendment.

reviews.outcome: Assess the impact assessment under the impact frame and the impact rubric.
instructions: Return every failed or unevaluable criterion identifier in unresolvedCriteria.

applicability.notApplicable: Never for a requirement amendment: a wording-only change still records that no design surface changes.

reviews.name: preservation

frame.family: Preservation of obligations the amendment does not authorize changing.
frame.subject: The realization file the amended requirement shares with other requirements, at the bytes the latest construction left.
frame.basis: The Run's worksite after the amendment: the requirements the amendment does not change, the files and tests traced only to them, and the trace.
authority: the unchanged requirements and their examples
frame.evidence: The candidate's current bytes, the unchanged requirements' examples evaluated through the system, and the declared source digests.
frame.excluded: Whether the amended rule is met (acceptance owns that), style and test-suite completeness.
frame.capability: A read-only assessor that did not write the subject; it edits nothing.
frame.result: One closed result under stdo://releases/v3.0.4/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-012-closed-results: satisfied, unmet (falsified) or indeterminate, with every failed or unevaluable criterion identifier.
frame.return: Returns to the parent Run. It is a declared prerequisite of UAT and a required review for parent completion. It does not accept the amendment.

reviews.outcome: Assess the shared realization under the preservation frame and the preservation rubric.
instructions: Return every failed or unevaluable criterion identifier in unresolvedCriteria.

applicability.notApplicable: When the amendment leaves the requirement's examples unchanged it changes only wording: no realization changes, so nothing needs preserving.

prerequisites.meaning: Declared order only. The runtime does not enforce it in this version; the joining function renders it into the stage instructions.
